clue.text: Bone, so long, found in French sea by Sarah

indicators.note: something found in another sits inside it, so the farewell goes within the sea word

parts.note: the French word for sea is mer
ta-ta is a casual goodbye, like so long
Sal is a pet form of the name Sarah

explanation.surface: A bone, said goodbye to, turns up in the sea off France beside a woman called Sarah.
explanation.walkthrough: 'so long' looks like part of the bone's description but is a casual farewell; 'found in' sets it inside the French sea, and 'by' adds Sarah's pet name.
explanation.definitionFit: It is one of the long bones of the foot, between ankle and toes, so a specific example of bone.

clue.text: Defence bird once needed, ending in court

parts.note: the moa was a giant flightless New Zealand bird, now extinct

indicators.note: the final letter of the word court is taken

explanation.surface: A defensive plan needed an extinct bird, ending up in a court of law.

clue.text: Spanish snack outside one company — knocked back pudding

explanation.definitionFit: Tapioca is a milky dessert made from cassava starch pearls, a classic British school dinner dish.

clue.text: They play rugby nine months of the year

nine of twelve months is three fourths of a year

explanation.surface: Rugby players who apparently take the summer off.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a set of rugby backs, and the fraction nine twelfths, which reduces to three fourths.

clue.text: Register royal wave

clue.text: Tyrant in boozy party holding court, dancing with famous model

parts.note: AA, Alcoholics Anonymous, is a group for people with a drinking problem

indicators.note: the letters of court are set dancing into a new order

explanation.walkthrough: 'boozy party' reads as a rave, but it is AA, the group for problem drinkers; 'dancing' rearranges COURT to UTOCR, which AA holds. The model is the Ford Model T, not a fashion model.
explanation.definitionFit: An autocrat rules with absolute, unchecked power, the essence of a despot.

clue.text: Indication of coldness from old rail company confronting clergyman

explanation.walkthrough: Ken Hom is a TV cook specialising in Chinese food.
explanation.definitionFit: Diamond-shaped floor tiles have a rhombus form, four equal sides with slanting angles.

clue.text: Official reading Mirror has this property

explanation.definitionFit: A looking glass gives back an image of whatever is before it; that thrown-back image is its characteristic.

clue.text: Left dislodging set of books in plain clothes

clue.text: How teacher may show approval of fine lecture

F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads

explanation.definitionFit: To tell someone off is to scold them; this British phrase means a reprimand or scolding.

clue.text: Belittle what an editor may do

clue.text: Easily animated voice managed to restrain cat near furniture item

clue.text: Relative starts to bring out giant rhubarb

indicators.note: the opening letters of the next two words are taken

parts.note: jumbo means giant, very large

explanation.surface: A mother's first attempts to grow huge rhubarb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rhubarb' is the vegetable in the surface but here means nonsense, British slang for meaningless chatter.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhubarb is informal British for nonsense or meaningless talk, just like gibberish or claptrap.

clue.text: Posh academician contacts tabloid about revealing heavenly body

clue.text: Track boxing extremists with killer hairstyle

clue.text: More tenacious athlete inclined to hide sign of nervousness

clue.text: On third of February, Wolves' home tie stirred a certain left-winger

clue.text: First answer here half-written when grappling in French magazine

clue.text: Tommy Cooper makes this joke finally after son out of prison

definitions.note: Tommy Atkins is slang for a British soldier

clue.text: Wise to reject vinyl worth a small amount

explanation.walkthrough: 'a small amount' takes YLWO from 'vinyl worth', and 'to reject' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: Owls are traditionally a symbol of wisdom, so being owl-like means sage or solemnly knowing.

clue.text: Ancient sport seen on prime battle site
